title: Level Up Your Bathroom In Timeless Matte White
bodyHtml:
Always Chic!

Our Matte White Collection is an invitation to create a space that’s effortlessly elegant, endlessly versatile, and uniquely yours.

With a stunning range of basins, toilets, and baths, all designed to harmonise flawlessly, this collection lets you bring your dream bathroom to life—without the usual lead times!

Explore Matte White Collection

A Range as Unique as your Design Vision

Discover a world of possibilities — from sleek countertop, wall-hung, and undercounter basins to elegant toilet suites, wall-faced pans, and a stunning array of freestanding baths, every piece is designed to inspire. Whether you’re crafting a modern oasis or a classic retreat, this collection has the perfect elements to bring your vision to life.

Our collection gives you the freedom to mix and match depending on your space and requirements, to create a bathroom that’s uniquely yours. Every piece is crafted to complement the others, ensuring a harmonious look no matter how you style it.

Why Matte White?

Matte white is the perfect blend of timeless elegance and modern sophistication. Its soft, tactile finish resists fingerprints and water spots, making it both beautiful and practical. Plus, its neutral tone pairs effortlessly with any design style, from bold and colourful to understated and serene.

No Wait — Just Wow

Our Matte White Collection is in stock and ready to ship, removing the standard colour option wait times of 10 - 12 weeks, so you can start transforming your space right away. No delays, no compromises—just premium quality, delivered fast.

Explore Curated Matte White

Explore our Curated Matte White Collection online or visit our nationwide distribution partners to see the pieces in person. With so many options and no wait times, there’s never been a better time to upgrade your space.

See complete specification and more images by clicking the button below, or call us on (02) 9601 1948 to organise a viewing in our showroom or one of our nationwide distributors.
